style_base: Cinematic premium editorial photography, warm morning light, shallow depth of field, razor sharp detail on the watch screen.
negative: No watermark, no logo, no brand marks, no cartoon, no night, no Asian or African features.

images.prompt: Close cinematic shot from the side: a modern young Slavic European man in dark sportswear walking along a sunlit park path in the morning, he lifts his left wrist close to his chest and looks down at his smartwatch, the watch screen is clearly visible and shows a bright red heartbeat pulse line with a heart icon and a heart rate number, his face is partly turned away, warm sun behind, background softly blurred, sharp macro detail on the watch face
